obligation: Execute validated start functions once at shared-VM instantiation, after active segments, before publication; preserve traps, provisional-root cleanup and caller ownership.
authority: WasmModule.start is the optional function index; with_start checks its domain and [] -> [] signature against the canonical pool. No execution flag, second interpreter or duplicated call ABI. Each instantiation initializes active segments then invokes the start using the existing call_user boundary. Error releases the provisional environment root; success publishes the rooted instance. Unbound APIs reject start-bearing modules. Wast preparation instantiates these modules immediately.
scope: Previous 65-file element/indirect-call ratchet plus every top-level pinned Wast file declaring a start section (deduplicated to 69). This checks shared instantiation callers and new eager start paths; no full suite run.

checks.node_oracle: active data and elements precede start; one start per instance; invokes do not repeat it; independent instance state
